headline: Oil Surges Past $111 as Houthi Strikes Hit Saudi Targets
summary: Brent crude oil prices extended gains above $111 per barrel following Houthi attacks on Saudi targets. The security concerns were compounded by a US government order for non-emergency personnel to leave the kingdom.
why: Geopolitical disruptions in key Middle Eastern oil-producing regions present immediate risks to global crude supply chains and energy inflation.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Attacks on energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia threaten physical crude supplies, driving immediate upward pressure on futures prices.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Higher underlying commodity prices increase profit margins for upstream oil and gas producers.

why_moved: Direct military strikes on oil infrastructure in a major exporting nation create immediate supply scarcity fears, triggering aggressive buying in energy markets.
